judgment_calls.decision: The check task fires on a single recorded SBP ≥ 180 or DBP ≥ 110 (routine vitals).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Averaged last-two readings as the page asks: not representable.

judgment_calls.decision: Applied to every item after "Sudden onset of:" (including seizure and dizziness), so these are distinct from plain recorded seizure/dizziness.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Plain warning-sign forms for seizure/dizziness so routine recordings match.

judgment_calls.decision: One Urgent priority rule for BP ≥ 180/110 with any red-box symptom; no escalation for hypertensive emergency.
judgment_calls.alternatives: "Very urgent" for hypertensive emergency ("Manage and refer urgently" vs "same day"). Chest pain, seizure and severe dyspnoea already carry Very urgent as warning signs.

judgment_calls.decision: Known kidney failure (eGFR < 15) → CKD stage 5 Known present; known kidney impairment (eGFR < 60) → Renal impairment Known present. eGFR is not representable.
judgment_calls.alternatives: End-stage renal disease; Kidney disease; CKD stage 3.

judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded: the diagnoses require readings on separate occasions ("Avoid diagnosing hypertension on one reading alone"), and SNOMED has no mild/moderate/severe hypertension FSNs.
judgment_calls.alternatives: possible Hypertensive disorder on a single reading ≥ 140/90 (rejected: the page does not say consider/suspect).
